## Summary
Add ADA accommodation support to exam delivery: time multipliers (1.5x, 2x) for extended-time students and screen reader accessibility for visually impaired students.

## User story
As a student with an approved ADA accommodation, I want my exam to automatically apply my time extension and screen reader optimizations, so that I receive my legally mandated accommodations without manual intervention.

## Why this matters
ADA compliance is legally required. If accommodations are not applied automatically, students must request manual overrides per exam, creating administrative burden and risk of missed accommodations. Time multiplier errors directly affect grades on high-stakes LCME exams.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AccommodationService reads student accommodations from profiles table
- [ ] time_multiplier (1.0, 1.5, 2.0) is applied to exam duration during session creation
- [ ] Extended time is reflected in the timer (ExamTimerBar shows correct extended time)
- [ ] Screen reader mode adds ARIA labels, role attributes, and live regions to exam UI
- [ ] All exam components pass axe-core accessibility audit (0 critical violations)
- [ ] Admin can set accommodations on student profile via existing admin panel
- [ ] Accommodations are logged for FERPA audit (which student, which accommodation, which exam)

## Schema changes
```sql
-- Add accommodation columns to profiles
ALTER TABLE public.profiles
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS time_multiplier NUMERIC(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.00
  CHECK (time_multiplier IN (1.00, 1.50, 2.00));

ALTER TABLE public.profiles
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS screen_reader_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

-- Accommodation audit log
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.accommodation_audit_log (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  student_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
  exam_id UUID NOT NULL,
  session_id UUID NOT NULL,
  time_multiplier NUMERIC(3,2) NOT NULL,
  screen_reader_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/exam-delivery/services/AccommodationService.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import type { Row } from '@journey/db/client';

type Profile = Row<'profiles'>;

export class AccommodationService {
  async getAccommodations(studentId: string): Promise<{
    time_multiplier: number;
    screen_reader_enabled: boolean;
  }> {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('time_multiplier, screen_reader_enabled')
      .eq('id', studentId)
      .single();

    return {
      time_multiplier: data?.time_multiplier ?? 1.0,
      screen_reader_enabled: data?.screen_reader_enabled ?? false,
    };
  }

  async logAccommodationUsage(
    studentId: string,
    examId: string,
    sessionId: string,
    accommodations: { time_multiplier: number; screen_reader_enabled: boolean }
  ) {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    await supabase.from('accommodation_audit_log').insert({
      student_id: studentId,
      exam_id: examId,
      session_id: sessionId,
      ...accommodations,
    });
  }
}

// features/exam-delivery/hooks/useAccommodations.ts
'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createBrowserClient } from '@journey/db/client';

export function useAccommodations(studentId: string) {
  const [screenReader, setScreenReader] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = createBrowserClient();
    supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('screen_reader_enabled')
      .eq('id', studentId)
      .single()
      .then(({ data }) => {
        if (data?.screen_reader_enabled) setScreenReader(true);
      });
  }, [studentId]);

  return { screenReader };
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E07/E07-S06.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Extended time student gets 1.5x duration on exam session', async ({ request }) => {
  // Set up student with time_multiplier = 1.5
  // Create session for 60-minute exam
  // Verify session.expires_at is 90 minutes from started_at
  const res = await request.post('/api/exams/test-exam-id/session');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  // Duration should be 90 minutes (60 * 1.5)
  const started = new Date(data.started_at);
  const expires = new Date(data.expires_at);
  const durationMin = (expires.getTime() - started.getTime()) / 60000;
  expect(durationMin).toBe(90);
});

test('Exam page passes axe-core accessibility audit', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/exam/test-session-id');
  // Run axe-core
  const violations = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const axe = await import('axe-core');
    const results = await axe.default.run();
    return results.violations.filter(v => v.impact === 'critical');
  });
  expect(violations).toHaveLength(0);
});

test('Screen reader mode adds ARIA labels to exam components', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/exam/test-session-id');
  const options = page.getByRole('radio');
  expect(await options.count()).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  // Timer should have aria-live
  const timer = page.getByTestId('exam-timer');
  await expect(timer).toHaveAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `ALTER TABLE public.profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS time_multiplier;`
2. `ALTER TABLE public.profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS screen_reader_enabled;`
3. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.accommodation_audit_log CASCADE;`
4. No Neo4j changes to revert.
5. `git stash && git checkout develop`
